name: Alms
text: Once per turn: If you have no Treasures in play, gain a card costing up to $4.

name: Amulet
text: Now and at the start of your next turn, choose one: +$1; or trash a card from your hand; or gain a Silver.

name: Artificer
text:
+1 Card
+1 Action
+$1
Discard any number of cards. You may gain a card costing exactly $1 per card discarded, onto your deck.

name: Ball
text: Take your -$1 token. Gain 2 cards each costing up to $4.

name: Bonfire
text: Trash up to 2 Coppers you have in play.

name: Borrow
text: Once per turn: +1 Buy. If your -1 Card token isn't on your deck, put it there and +$1.

name: Bridge Troll
text: Each other player takes their -$1 token. On this turn and your next turn, cards cost $1 less. Now and at the start of your next turn: +1 Buy.

name: Caravan Guard
text:
+1 Card
+1 Action
At the start of your next turn, +$1.
---
When another player plays an Attack card, you may first play this from your hand.

name: Champion
text:
+1 Action
For the rest of the game, when another player plays an Attack, it doesn't affect you, and when you play an Action card, you first get +1 Action.
(This is not in the Supply.)

name: Coin of the Realm
text:
$1
Put this on your Tavern mat.
---
After you play an Action card, you may call this, for +2 Actions.

name: Disciple
text:
You may play an Action card from your hand twice. Gain a copy of it.
---
When you discard this from play, you may exchange it for a Teacher.
(This is not in the Supply.)

name: Distant Lands
text:
Put this on your Tavern mat.
---
Worth 4 VP if on your Tavern mat at the end of the game (otherwise worth 0 VP).

name: Dungeon
text:
+1 Action
Now and at the start of your next turn: +2 Cards, then discard 2 cards.

name: Duplicate
text:
Put this on your Tavern mat.
---
When you gain a card costing up to $6, you may call this, to gain a copy of that card.

name: Expedition
text: Draw 2 extra cards for your next hand.

name: Ferry
text: Move your -$2 token to an Action Supply pile. (Cards from that pile cost $2 less on your turns.)

name: Fugitive
text:
+2 Cards
+1 Action
Discard a card.
---
When you discard this from play, you may exchange it for a Disciple.
(This is not in the Supply.)

name: Gear
text:
+2 Cards
Set aside up to 2 cards from your hand face down (under this). At the start of your next turn, put them into your hand.

name: Giant
text: Turn your Journey token over (it starts face up). Then if it's face down, +$1. If it's face up, +$5, and each other player reveals the top card of their deck, trashes it if it costs from $3 to $6, and otherwise discards it and gains a Curse.

name: Guide
text:
+1 Card
+1 Action
Put this on your Tavern mat.
---
At the start of your turn, you may call this, to discard your hand and draw 5 cards.

name: Haunted Woods
text: At the start of your next turn, +3 Cards. Until then, when any other player gains a card they bought, they put their hand onto their deck in any order.

name: Hero
text:
+$2
Gain a Treasure.
---
When you discard this from play, you may exchange it for a Champion.
(This is not in the Supply.)

name: Hireling
text:
At the start of each of your turns for the rest of the game:
+1 Card

name: Inheritance
text: Once per game: Set aside a non-Command non-Duration Action card from the Supply costing up to $4. Move your Estate token to it. (During your turns, Estates are also Command Actions with "Play the card with your Estate token, leaving it there.")

name: Lost Arts
text: Move your +1 Action token to an Action Supply pile. (When you play a card from that pile, you first get +1 Action.)

name: Lost City
text:
+2 Cards
+2 Actions
---
When you gain this, each other player draws a card.

name: Magpie
text:
+1 Card
+1 Action
Reveal the top card of your deck. If it's a Treasure, put it into your hand. If it's an Action or Victory card, gain a Magpie.

name: Messenger
text:
+1 Buy
+$2
You may put your deck into your discard pile.
---
When this is the first card you gain in your Buy phase, gain a card costing up to $4, and each other player gains a copy of it.

name: Miser
text: Choose one: Put a Copper from your hand onto your Tavern mat; or +$1 per Copper on your Tavern mat.

name: Mission
text: Take an extra turn after this one (but not a 3rd turn in a row), during which you can't buy cards. (You can still buy Events.)

name: Page
text:
+1 Card
+1 Action
---
When you discard this from play, you may exchange it for a Treasure Hunter.

name: Pathfinding
text: Move your +1 Card token to an Action Supply pile. (When you play a card from that pile, you first get +1 Card.)

name: Peasant
text:
+1 Buy
+$1
---
When you discard this from play, you may exchange it for a Soldier.

name: Pilgrimage
text: Once per turn: Turn your Journey token over (it starts face up); then if it's face up, choose up to 3 differently named cards you have in play and gain a copy of each.

name: Plan
text: Move your Trashing token to an Action Supply pile. (When you gain a card from that pile, you may trash a card from your hand.)

name: Port
text:
+1 Card
+2 Actions
---
When you gain this, gain another Port (that doesn't come with another).

name: Quest
text: You may discard an Attack, two Curses, or six cards. If you do, gain a Gold.

name: Raid
text: Gain a Silver per Silver you have in play. Each other player puts their -1 Card token on their deck.

name: Ranger
text:
+1 Buy
Turn your Journey token over (it starts face up). Then if it's face up, +5 Cards.

name: Ratcatcher
text:
+1 Card
+1 Action
Put this on your Tavern mat.
---
At the start of your turn, you may call this, to trash a card from your hand.

name: Raze
text:
+1 Action
Trash this or a card from your hand. Look at one card from the top of your deck per $1 the trashed card costs. Put one of them into your hand and discard the rest.

name: Relic
text:
$2
Each other player puts their -1 Card token on their deck.

name: Royal Carriage
text:
+1 Action
Put this on your Tavern mat.
---
Directly after you finish playing an Action card, if it's still in play, you may call this, to replay that Action.

name: Save
text: Once per turn: +1 Buy. Set aside a card from your hand, and put it into your hand at end of turn (after drawing).

name: Scouting Party
text:
+1 Buy
Look at the top 5 cards of your deck. Discard 3 and put the rest back in any order.

name: Seaway
text: Gain an Action card costing up to $4. Move your +1 Buy token to its pile. (When you play a card from that pile, you first get +1 Buy.)

name: Soldier
text:
+$2
+$1 per other Attack you have in play. Each other player with 4 or more cards in hand discards a card.
---
When you discard this from play, you may exchange it for a Fugitive.
(This is not in the Supply.)

name: Storyteller
text:
+1 Action
Play up to 3 Treasures from your hand. Then +1 Card, and pay all of your $ and +1 Card per $1 you paid.

name: Swamp Hag
text: At the start of your next turn, +$3. Until then, when any other player gains a card they bought, they gain a Curse.

name: Teacher
text:
Put this on your Tavern mat.
---
At the start of your turn, you may call this, to move your +1 Card, +1 Action, +1 Buy, or +$1 token to an Action Supply pile you have no tokens on. (When you play a card from that pile, you first get that bonus.)
(This is not in the Supply.)

name: Trade
text: Trash up to 2 cards from your hand. Gain a Silver per card you trashed.

name: Training
text: Move your +$1 token to an Action Supply pile. (When you play a card from that pile, you first get +$1.)

name: Transmogrify
text:
+1 Action
Put this on your Tavern mat.
---
At the start of your turn, you may call this, to trash a card from your hand, and gain a card costing up to $1 more than it into your hand.

name: Travelling Fair
text:
+2 Buys
When you gain a card this turn, you may put it onto your deck.

name: Treasure Hunter
text:
+1 Action
+$1
Gain a Silver per card the player to your right gained on their last turn.
---
When you discard this from play, you may exchange it for a Warrior.
(This is not in the Supply.)

name: Treasure Trove
text:
$2
Gain a Gold and a Copper.

name: Warrior
text:
+2 Cards
Once per Traveller you have in play (including this), each other player discards the top card of their deck and trashes it if it costs $3 or $4.
---
When you discard this from play, you may exchange it for a Hero.
(This is not in the Supply.)

name: Wine Merchant
text:
+1 Buy
+$4
Put this on your Tavern mat.
---
At the end of your Buy phase, if you have at least $2 unspent, you may discard this from your Tavern mat.
